title: Cross-Lingual Reusability of LLM Pipelines: Financial Extraction, Multilingual Reasoning, and Semantic Screening
abstract: arXiv:2610.27043v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Financial institutions increasingly deploy large language models (LLMs) in multilingual markets, raising a practical question: can pipelines developed and validated in English be reused across languages, or must they be rebuilt per locale? We test cross-lingual reusability along three dimensions--accuracy, reasoning-effort transfer, and behavioural stability--through three complementary tasks. Task 1 (cheque extraction) and Task 2 (Mintaka QA with pinned evidence across nine languages and nine model-effort configurations) test whether accuracy and effort settings transfer; Task 3 (FinanceBench pilot, 50 items over SEC 10-K filings in four languages) validates whether these patterns generalise to financial content. Accuracy reusability is broadly confirmed: Gemini 3.5 Flash achieves 95.2-97.6% extraction accuracy across prompt languages, and FinanceBench per-language means span 5.8pp (77.1-82.9%), though the language-difficulty ranking

translated_title: 大语言模型管线的跨语言可复用性：金融信息抽取、多语言推理与语义筛选
translated_abstract: 金融机构日益在多语言市场中部署大语言模型（LLM），这引出一个实际问题：在英语中开发和验证的管线能否跨语言复用，还是必须针对每个地区重新构建？我们通过三个互补任务，从三个维度——准确性、推理努力迁移和行为稳定性——检验跨语言可复用性。任务1（支票信息抽取）和任务2（跨九种语言、九种模型-推理努力配置、固定证据的Mintaka问答）测试准确性和努力设置能否迁移；任务3（FinanceBench试点，针对四种语言的SEC 10-K文件进行50项测试）验证这些模式是否可推广至金融内容。准确性可复用性得到广泛证实：Gemini 3.5 Flash在不同提示语言下达到95.2-97.6%的抽取准确率，FinanceBench各语言平均值跨度为5.8个百分点（77.1-82.9%），尽管语言难度排名（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过支票信息抽取、多语言问答和金融文档分析三项任务，验证了在英语中开发和验证的大语言模型管线可以直接跨语言复用，准确性在各语言间保持高度稳定。
en_tdlr: This study validates through three tasks—cheque extraction, multilingual QA, and financial document analysis—that LLM pipelines developed and validated in English can be broadly reused across languages with stable accuracy.
